name: Shandong Dongyue Organosilicon Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Dongyue Organosilicon Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of silicon materials in China. It offers monomers, intermediates, silicone rubbers, silicone oils, silicone resins; and fumed silicas; deep-processing products. The company exports its products to the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Belgium, India, South Korea, and internationally. Shandong Dongyue Organosilicon Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Zibo, China.
